description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for loading, preprocessing, and hit-testing GeoJSON country data for 3D globe visualization using Three.js. It provides geographic calculations, point-in-polygon tests, and geometry building for rendering country outlines.

methods.name: latLonToVector3(latDeg, lonDeg, r = 1.001)
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude in degrees to a 3D vector on a sphere with radius r (default 1.001), using spherical coordinate mathematics.

methods.name: computeBounds(coords)
methods.description: Calculates a simple bounding box (min/max latitude and longitude) for an array of coordinates, allowing quick rejection in spatial queries.

methods.name: pointInPolygonLonLat(point, polygon)
methods.description: Implements ray casting algorithm to determine if a point (lon, lat) is inside a polygon defined by an array of [lon, lat] points.

methods.name: pointInFeatureLonLat(point, geometry)
methods.description: Checks if a point is inside a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon feature in lon/lat space, accounting for holes.

methods.name: buildCountryOutlineGeometry(geometry, radius = 1.003)
methods.description: Builds a Three.js buffer geometry representing country borders as line segments, projecting polygon rings onto a sphere.

methods.name: preprocessFeatures(features)
methods.description: Processes GeoJSON features by ensuring rings are closed, computing bounding boxes, and caching data for hit-testing.

methods.name: useCountries()
methods.description: React hook that loads GeoJSON country data, preprocesses it, and provides functions for spatial lookups and outline geometry retrieval.
